page.layout: One printed page (p. 522). Running head at top: "HABAKUK" with chapter reference at top right. Below: centred title "PRÆLUDIUM." with "AD" and "CAP. III: 1-3. a." beneath, then heading "EXPOSITIO TEXTUALIS." Then a verse citation set indented with its quoted text in italic. Then the main text in one full-width column, starting with a historiated initial "A". Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf lies between the title lines and above the heading; it is not transcribed.

main_text.l: PRÆLUDIUM.
AD CAP. III: 1-3. a.
EXPOSITIO TEXTUALIS.

l.i: timui : Jehovah ! molitio tua est vita ejus in
medio annorum : in medio annorum notifices ;

main_text.l: §. 1. ANsa, quæ Prophetæ sequentem expressit
supplicationem, exponitur primo
hujus versus colo ; quo propheta ad
Jehovam defert, quid oraculum antecedens
in animo suo effecerit. De antecedente suâ per-
ceptione dicit, audivi auditionem tuam : Conf. Obad.
verf. 1. Verbum cum voce suæ derivationis construction
censetur inter elegantias Hebraicæ linguæ. Audire
auditionem notat audire auribus, & mente perci-
pere, quicquid de aliquo subjecto dicebatur ; & ad audiendum
promulgabatur. Quæ proximè ad Prophetæ
institutionem, sed quasi in publico foro de Deo judice dixerat
Spiritus Sanctus, se cum attentione animi audivisse
profitetur. Verùm consequens istius apud animum suum
fuisse notat timorem & consternationem quandam ;
addit enim & timui. Timor est passio animi ex perce-
ptione,

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut letter, printed as "ANsa" in the transcription above; the likely reading is "Ansa" with the initial decorative. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the title area and was excluded. The text runs to the bottom of the page; there is no catchword, signature or footnote. Line "in irâ miserari recorderis." is printed with the closing period as shown. The word "ptione," at the end is a line-end break of "perceptione," and the hyphen is not printed, so the word is written whole in the paragraph. Faint ink marks in the margins are not text.
